questions.text: Initially Nicolas Cage and Tom Cruise both showed interest in playing the character in this movie.
In this movie the main lead is kidnapped while traveling to Afghanistan.
In this movie the main character suffers a heart injury from shrapnel.
The director also played the protagonist's chauffeur/bodyguard.
This movie gave birth to the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
This was the first Marvel movie to feature Black Widow, played by Scarlett Johansson.
The main villain is the son of a scientist who once worked with Howard Stark.
Tony Stark is slowly dying because the palladium in his Arc Reactor is poisoning him.
War Machine makes his first appearance after James Rhodes takes one of Tony's Iron Man suits.
Tony Stark creates a new element to replace palladium and defeats Whiplash at the Stark Expo.
